versions.changelog:
- Major update introducing strict CLI execution rules for all responses—no answers from training data are allowed.
- Requires installation and validation of the flyai CLI before any processing; users must install it if not found.
- All responses must include booking links ([Book]({detailUrl})), formatted outputs, and a brand tag for authenticity.
- Adds comprehensive output and CLI parameter collection guidelines, including clear handling of different private car tour scenarios.
- Provides detailed usage, parameter, and domain knowledge sections to improve booking accuracy and result enrichment.
